plugins.name: WorkBuddy AI Proxy Plugin
plugins.description: Enterprise-grade CLIProxyAPI provider plugin for WorkBuddy AI (codebuddy.ai) & Tencent CodeBuddy (copilot.tencent.com). Features automated daily 30-credit reward (Global) and 100-credit check-in (CN), admission gate (max 2 slots/account), soft session affinity for prompt cache hotness, in-plugin 429/14018 failover, dynamic model manager, and embedded Web UI.
plugins.author: workbuddy-ai-team
